# Boring Internet

Purpose: Human-curated directory to discover websites, find new launches, and submit new and upcoming websites.

Primary crawl targets:
- / — Main directory, search, category filters, and featured links.
- /discover-websites — Intent-focused page to jump website to website.
- /new-websites — New and upcoming website launches.
- /trending — Ranked sites by community voting.
- /collections — Curated collections of related websites.
- /blog — Editorial notes about launches and curation.
- /submit — Submission page for new launches.

Priority keywords:
- bored button
- website to website
- discover websites
- find websites
- launch new websites
- new and upcoming websites
